title: Immunization Services Decision Table - Credit for Documented Outside Doses
content:
**Pharmacy Clinical Services decision table - Immunization Services, resumed series**

**Rule.** When a patient resumes a series on a new course, doses documented by another provider on the earlier course are credited as follows, counting the cash-paid entries recorded from another provider that carry a lot number within the credit window. Where such documented entries exist and the earlier course carries an invalidation entry, the documented entries less the invalidation entries are credited. Where such documented entries exist and the earlier course carries no invalidation entry, every documented entry is credited. Where no such documented entry exists, no outside dose is credited.

## Terms

- **Documented entry.** A dose entry on the earlier course that names no Kestrel store (it was recorded from another provider), was paid in cash and carries a lot number, and lies within the credit window (fewer whole calendar months separate its date from today than the window's months).
- **Invalidation entry.** An entry on the earlier course recording that a dose does not count. Every invalidation entry on the earlier course is counted, whatever its date.

## Condition matrix

| Documented entries within the window | Invalidation entries on the earlier course | Outside doses credited |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | 1 or more | The documented entries less the invalidation entries |
| 1 or more | None | Every documented entry |
| None | Any | None |

An entry recorded from another provider that is billed to a pharmacy benefit, or that carries no lot number, is not a documented entry under this table.

## Worked cases (hypothetical records)

- *Hypothetical 1.* Two documented entries within the window; the earlier course carries one invalidation entry. 2 less 1: one outside dose is credited.
- *Hypothetical 2.* Two documented entries within the window; no invalidation entry. Both are credited: two outside doses.
- *Hypothetical 3.* One cash-paid entry from another provider with no lot number, and no other outside entry. There is no documented entry, so no outside dose is credited under this table.
- *Hypothetical 4.* One documented entry dated so long ago that it lies outside the window. It is not counted, so no outside dose is credited.

## Point of judgement

With documented entries present, each invalidation entry on the earlier course lowers the outside doses credited by one.
